test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

We didn't / went yesterday as / it rained yesterday.
solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "We didn't / went yesterday as / it rained yesterday." contains a grammatical error.
 
• The error lies in the use of **"went"** after **"didn't."** 
 
• In this context, the base form of the verb** "go"** should be used after** "didn't."**
 
• Therefore, option 4, "went yesterday as" is the part of the sentence that contains the error.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'We didn't go yesterday as it rained yesterday.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "it rained yesterday" This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• Option 2: "No error" The sentence has a grammatical error hence this option isn't correct.
 
• Option 3: "We didn't" This part of the sentence is also correct and does not contain any errors.
